annotations.title: Benchmark your MRR against category peers

description: Returns where an MRR ranks among fresh same-category MRR peers (rank of N + 1 comparable). Example: {"category":"customer-support","mrr":2000} -> your rank among the customer-support MRR peers + 1 comparable. Also: N, basis, verification date, peer caveat; no growth numbers yet; your MRR is never stored. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key). Full answer (percentile where 10+ peers, 5 sourced comparables): $0.05 via x402 (full: true for the terms), or included with Builder/Team/Pro keys and a $9 Category Report token (report_token).

category.description: Category slug, e.g. customer-support, automation-platforms, sales-gtm, indie-solo (see list_categories).

full.description: true = ask for the full answer (needs a Builder/Team/Pro key or a Category Report token for this category; otherwise you get the free answer plus how to unlock).

months_live.description: Optional months since launch (0-600). Accepted but ignored for now.

mrr.description: Your monthly recurring revenue in USD, e.g. 2000 (greater than 0, at most 100000000). Not stored.

report_token.description: Optional: the 48-hex token from a Category Report for this category (unlocks full answers for its 7-day window).
